consequence.statement: Operators can now configure resource requests and limits for GrafanaAgent pods through Helm values; previously this was not configurable.

original.statement: The Loki Helm chart now allows defining resource requests and limits for GrafanaAgent pods.

consequence.statement: No operational consequence if the operator does nothing: the change adds an optional Helm setting for GrafanaAgent pod resources, and the evidence describes no changed default or broken behaviour.

corrected.statement: The Loki Helm chart now lets operators optionally define resource requests/limits for GrafanaAgent pods; environments that do not use the new option are unaffected.

decision.reason: [ev-ef448e5a23b4] lists this under Features and says only that the Helm chart now "allows the definition" of resources for GrafanaAgent pods. That is an opt-in capability. Nothing in it says a default or existing behaviour changes for an operator who does nothing. The proposed statement describes the new option, not something that happens to an exposed environment, so behavior-change (review) claims more than the evidence supports. The fitting consequence is none (informational).
